display.title: My Miracle: Surviving COVID (Chanukah)
display.summary_short: A short Chanukah telling of how the storyteller survived a critical case of COVID, and his thanks to Hashem and to everyone who davened for him.
display.summary_long: Because Chanukah is the time to publicize miracles, the storyteller shares his own. In the week of Purim he fell ill, tested positive for COVID and was intubated and kept in an induced coma for about a month. His lungs stopped working, the doctors did everything they could, and his family was being prepared for the worst, until Hashem turned things around. His children had no explanation except that Hashem runs the world and still has missions for him. He thanks all of Klal Yisroel for their prayers and tells of a six-year-old who told his father that davening works when he saw the storyteller walking in the street. He remembers nothing of the weeks he was unconscious, only waking up to learn he had missed Pesach. This short recording ends just as he begins to share more highlights; a longer telling of the same story exists.
display.lesson: Only Hashem runs the world, and davening works.
